content: The FlexRay Interface shall perform a PDU transmission with im- mediate buffer access (see 9.1), only if the following restriction regarding static config- uration apply: • The PDU must be the only PDU in a FlexRay Frame (L-SDU). It is not packed into a FlexRay Frame together with other PDUs (i.e., the mapping between this PDU and the respective L-SDU is a 1:1 association). • The PDU must be located at the beginning of the L-SDU. • There is no update-bit for immediate PDUs configured.
